page_title: COM 6-0 TOR | Como v Torino 24/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+1' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+1' Como control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
90' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
90' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the left post.
89' Rafael Obrador (Torino) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
87' The number of offsides is – 1:7.
87' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

84' The cross into the penalty area from Maxence Caqueret (Como) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
84' Maxence Caqueret (Como) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

83' Nicolas-Gerrit Kuhn (Como) wins some space for himself around the penalty spot and manages to produce a promising header. One of the defenders stops his effort before it gets to the goalkeeper, making him redundant.
79' Duvan Zapata (Torino) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.

76' 6 - 0 Maxence Caqueret (Como) quickly gets to a rebound. He is not worried how far out he is and slams the ball towards the goal. To the amazement of all, it goes inside the right post. He makes it 6:0 with this magnificent strike.
74' 15:6 – the total goal attempt statistics. The current number of shots on goal is 6:1.
73' Cesc Fabregas prepares a substitution. Anastasios Douvikas is replaced by Alberto Moreno (Como).
73' That's the end of the game for Nico Paz, who is replaced by Ivan Smolcic (Como).
73' The flag goes up and the referee blows his whistle - another offside by Che Adams (Torino), who has already been caught several times today.
70' 5 - 0 Nicolas-Gerrit Kuhn (Como) produces a moment of pure magic and scores a spectacular goal by striking the ball into the top left corner of the net!
68' Cesc Fabregas has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Sergi Roberto (Como) replacing Maximo Perrone.
68' It will be a substitution. Maxence Caqueret (Como) is ready to enter the pitch as Martin Baturina walks off.
68' We are about to witness a substitution. Nicolas-Gerrit Kuhn (Como) is replacing Jesus Rodriguez.
68' Here is a change. Adrien Tameze is going off and Marco Baroni gives the last tactical orders to Rafael Obrador (Torino).
68' The referee allows time for a substitution. Cyril Ngonge will be replaced by Duvan Zapata (Torino).
68' Marco Baroni has decided to make a change. Faustino Anjorin (Torino) replaces Emirhan Ilkhan.

66' 4 - 0 Anastasios Douvikas (Como) runs on to a clever pass from Martin Baturina and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He still has work to do but finishes with aplomb into the back of the net.
66' Martin Baturina (Como) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
65' A pass from Che Adams (Torino) is intercepted by Jean Butez and the move breaks down.
64' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) plays a one-two with Emirhan Ilkhan, but the move breaks down.
61' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
61' Poor challenge! Lucas Da Cunha (Como) is penalised for tripping and Ermano Feliciani blows his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Torino.
59' 3 - 0 Goal! Lucas Da Cunha (Como) directs his penalty into the top left corner and past Alberto Paleari.
59' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
58' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Como!
56' There's a break in play and referee Ermano Feliciani must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Como using VAR. This could be interesting!
55' Guillermo Maripan (Torino) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
54' Martin Baturina (Como) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Martin Baturina (Como) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
53' Cyril Ngonge (Torino) is repeatedly being caught offside, but this is to be expected given that he always plays on the shoulder of the last defender.
52' Cyril Ngonge (Torino) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.

51' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.
50' A clumsy foul by Marc Oliver Kempf (Como) and Ermano Feliciani blows his whistle. Free kick. Torino will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
49' Emirhan Ilkhan (Torino) sends a long cross over to Marcus Pedersen, but Jean Butez comes forward to gather the ball.
47' Maximo Perrone (Como) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
46' A pass from Anastasios Douvikas (Como) is intercepted by Alberto Paleari and the move breaks down.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Cyril Ngonge (Torino) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Como.
45+1' Guillermo Maripan (Torino) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' Nico Paz (Como) is quick to pick up the loose pass from Martin Baturina. He tries his luck from mid-range, but it goes well wide of the right post.
45' Anastasios Douvikas (Como) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
44' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Cesare Casadei, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball goes out of play and Como will have a goal kick.
43' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) takes the free kick and immediately restarts play with a short pass.
42' Guillermo Maripan (Torino) commits a rough challenge and Ermano Feliciani blows his whistle for a foul. Como win a free kick.
39' CHANCE! Martin Baturina finds Jesus Rodriguez (Como) with a sweet pass, but he can't find the target as his effort from inside the box goes just over the bar!

38' Jean Butez (Como) shows his brilliant passing ability after picking out Mergim Vojvoda with a fine lofted pass. Mergim Vojvoda (Como) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
37' A pass by Marc Oliver Kempf (Como) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
35' Cesare Casadei (Torino) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
34' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) takes a long-range free kick and whips it into the box. The goalkeeper reads it well and leaps high to intercept the ball.
33' Referee Ermano Feliciani sees the trip by Adrien Tameze (Torino) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. That's a free kick to Como.
31' 7:4 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. The number of shots on goal at present is 3:0.
31' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) connects with a pass inside the box, but his effort goes well wide of the left post.

29' Alberto Paleari was forced into action to thwart Anastasios Douvikas (Como). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom left corner but couldn't beat the keeper.
29' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Jean Butez intercepts the ball.

28' A through ball from Nico Paz (Como) fails to reach Martin Baturina as one of the defending players reacts brilliantly to intercept the effort. If the pass had been produced a little bit earlier, Martin Baturina could have got into a promising position.
28' Mergim Vojvoda (Como) attempts to surprise the keeper with a nice shot, but it lacks more accuracy and goes way wide of the left post.
27' Cyril Ngonge (Torino) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle.
26' Mergim Vojvoda (Como) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Anastasios Douvikas, but Alberto Paleari displays great awareness to stop him.

25' Che Adams (Torino) finds himself some space to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick, and from near the penalty spot he attempts to score with a header. His effort lacks accuracy and goes well wide of the right post.
24' Ermano Feliciani blows the whistle, Lucas Da Cunha (Como) is penalised for a foul. Torino are awarded a free kick.
23' Adrien Tameze (Torino) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Como will take a free kick.
21' Ardian Ismajli (Torino) is substituted due to injury. Marco Baroni gives a chance to Guillermo Maripan.
20' Ardian Ismajli (Torino) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
20' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Nico Paz (Como). Ermano Feliciani saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
19' Adrien Tameze (Torino) takes a neat pass, dummies a defender and slams the ball well wide of the left post from the edge of the box.
18' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
18' Cyril Ngonge (Torino) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Torino force their opponents to concede a corner.
17' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
16' 2 - 0 Goal! Martin Baturina (Como) is teed up on the edge of the box by Alex Valle, and his howitzer of a shot into the bottom left corner gives the keeper no chance. 2:0.
16' The possession of the ball – 56:44.
14' Ardian Ismajli (Torino) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
14' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
13' A pass lands at the feet of Che Adams (Torino) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
12' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.

8' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Superb finishing from Anastasios Douvikas (Como). Lucas Da Cunha plays a fantastic through ball and finds Anastasios Douvikas (Como), who reacts quickly to get in front of the goalkeeper and fire a close-range shot into the right side of the goal. It's now 1:0.
7' Martin Baturina (Como) tries to find Jesus Rodriguez, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
6' Jacobo Ramon (Como) sends a long cross over to Anastasios Douvikas, but Alberto Paleari comes forward to gather the ball.
6' The linesman raises his flag. Che Adams (Torino) is adjudged offside.
5' The ball is cleared after Valentino Lazaro (Torino) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
4' A cross from Mergim Vojvoda gives Jesus Rodriguez (Como) a great chance right in the middle of the box, but he chooses the wrong option and sends a header just wide of the right post.
4' The Como players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
2' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
1' Nico Paz (Como) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Torino will have the kick-off.
